purpose: Corroborate non-consumer investment ideas with the closest available evidence of money committed, capacity used or equipment ordered. Social discussion is optional context, not the universal proof source.

evidence_strength.name: money_committed
evidence_strength.interpretation: Closest public evidence of purchase demand.

evidence_strength.name: capacity_committed_or_used
evidence_strength.interpretation: Strong operational evidence, but check price, cancellation and margin.

evidence_strength.name: purchase_preparation
evidence_strength.interpretation: Shows intent and project progress, not a completed purchase.

evidence_strength.name: attention_only
evidence_strength.interpretation: Useful for discovery or market-awareness checks; never treated as revenue.

airlines.question: Are travellers actually buying tickets or using capacity, and is the change specific enough to affect one airline?

free_or_public_sources.name: ARC Sales Statistics
free_or_public_sources.evidence: Monthly U.S. travel-agency ticket sales and ticketing trends based on settled transactions.
free_or_public_sources.limits: Aggregate U.S. agency channel; not a complete carrier-specific global booking feed.

free_or_public_sources.name: EUROCONTROL European Aviation Overview
free_or_public_sources.evidence: Weekly flights, airline and airport performance, traffic and delay data.
free_or_public_sources.limits: Operational traffic is not ticket revenue; carrier cost attribution still needs issuer evidence.

free_or_public_sources.name: UK CAA airline and punctuality data
free_or_public_sources.evidence: Monthly punctuality plus airline route capacity, passenger, load-factor and traffic statistics.
free_or_public_sources.limits: Published with lag and UK scope.

free_or_public_sources.name: US BTS T-100
free_or_public_sources.evidence: Passengers, seat-miles, load factors, enplanements and carrier traffic.
free_or_public_sources.limits: Lagged and U.S.-focused; international detail may be released later.

free_or_public_sources.name: US DOT Air Travel Consumer Reports
free_or_public_sources.evidence: Delays, cancellations, complaints, oversales and service failures.
free_or_public_sources.limits: Cost exposure must still be translated into carrier economics.

free_or_public_sources.name: Direct booking and fare-inventory panel
free_or_public_sources.evidence: Repeated same-flight fare, fare-class availability and schedule capture from airline or licensed GDS routes.
free_or_public_sources.limits: A disappearing fare bucket can reflect inventory controls or schedule changes, not only new bookings. Seat maps are not sold-seat ledgers.

paid_fallbacks: OAG or Cirium schedule and traffic data
minimum_corroboration: one independent operational or issuer source

industrial_and_data_centers.question: Has somebody committed money, power, land or equipment to the project, and which listed company is contractually exposed?

free_or_public_sources.name: Singapore GeBIZ
free_or_public_sources.evidence: Singapore public-sector quotations, tenders and awards.
free_or_public_sources.limits: Public procurement only; an open tender is not an award.

free_or_public_sources.name: EU TED and TED Open Data
free_or_public_sources.evidence: EU public procurement notices and contract awards with reusable data.
free_or_public_sources.limits: Coverage follows public procurement rules and misses private hyperscaler orders.

free_or_public_sources.name: SAM.gov
free_or_public_sources.limits: Federal demand only; separate opportunity from awarded contract.

free_or_public_sources.name: CanadaBuys procurement data
free_or_public_sources.evidence: Downloadable Canadian federal tender notices and contract awards.
free_or_public_sources.limits: Federal scope; provinces have separate portals.

free_or_public_sources.name: Planning, building and environmental permits
free_or_public_sources.evidence: Approved facility size, cooling system, construction phase and named applicant or contractor.
free_or_public_sources.limits: A permit does not prove construction or a supplier award.

free_or_public_sources.name: Utility large-load and interconnection records
free_or_public_sources.evidence: Megawatts requested, service agreements, substations, energisation and expected in-service dates.
free_or_public_sources.limits: Queues include projects that will never be built; require milestones and deposits or signed agreements.

free_or_public_sources.name: Issuer orders, backlog and shipment disclosures
free_or_public_sources.evidence: Named customer order, purchase commitment, backlog, capacity reservation, shipment or recognised revenue.
free_or_public_sources.limits: Avoid double-counting multi-year framework agreements and already-guided backlog.

free_or_public_sources.name: Distributor quote, stock and lead-time panel
free_or_public_sources.evidence: Repeated identical equipment and fulfilment terms across authorised distributors.
free_or_public_sources.limits: Inventory movement is not sales unless the same listing, seller and fulfilment mode are preserved.

paid_fallbacks: Dodge Construction Network or ConstructConnect project data
minimum_corroboration: contract award, signed order, service agreement or verified construction milestone

routing_rules: Consumer product demand uses purchases, retailer availability and independent user behavior.
Airline demand uses settled ticket sales, fares, capacity, passenger traffic and load factors before social discussion.
Industrial demand uses awards, orders, backlog, permits, grid and commissioning evidence before social discussion.
An open tender, permit application, grid queue entry or job posting shows preparation, not completed demand.
Two weak attention sources do not equal one purchase source.
Promotion requires a company-specific economic bridge and an expectations gap, regardless of portal count.
